gloss: in a rush; all at once; suddenly

definitions.gloss: in a rush; all at once
definitions.explanation: A large amount or many people suddenly moving or appearing at once.

examples.japanese: ⟦{観客|かんきゃく}→観客：02556_kankyaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧どっと⟦{笑|わら}った→笑う：00685_warau⟧。
⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧どっと⟦{増|ふ}えた→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
⟦{開店|かいてん}→開店：14569_kaiten⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{同時|どうじ}に→同時に：22223_doujini⟧⟦{客|きゃく}→客：00865_kyaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧どっと⟦{押|お}し{寄|よ}せた→押し寄せる：06733_oshiyoseru⟧。
examples.english: Customers rushed in all at once the moment the store opened.

examples.japanese: ⟦{疲|つか}れ→疲れ：03518_tsukare⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧どっと⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: Fatigue suddenly hit me all at once.

examples.japanese: どっと⟦{倒|たお}れた→倒れる：01160_taoreru⟧。

⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{終|お}わった→終わる：00567_owaru⟧⟦{途端|とたん}→途端：03462_totan⟧、⟦{緊張|きんちょう}→緊張：02494_kinchou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{解|と}けて→解ける：04371_tokeru⟧どっと⟦{疲|つか}れ→疲れ：03518_tsukare⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: The moment the exam ended, the tension released and exhaustion hit me all at once.

notes:
USAGE:
どっと + verb

Marks an arrival rather than a process: a mass of people, work, or feeling that was held back somewhere else lands all at once. This is why it so often follows a moment of release — a punchline, an opening door, the end of an exam.
The subject is overwhelmed by the volume, not merely surprised by the timing. どっと⟦{疲|つか}れ→疲れ：03518_tsukare⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧ is the classic case: the tiredness was accumulating unnoticed and arrives in one wave once the strain lifts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- どっと⟦{押|お}し{寄|よ}せる→押し寄せる：06733_oshiyoseru⟧ (to surge in)
- どっと⟦{湧|わ}く→湧く：13321_waku_welling⟧ (to well up suddenly)
- どっと⟦{泣|な}く→泣く：00655_naku⟧ (to burst into tears)
- どっと⟦{笑|わら}う→笑う：00685_warau⟧ (to burst out laughing)
- どっと⟦{倒|たお}れる→倒れる：01160_taoreru⟧ (to collapse)
- どっと⟦{疲|つか}れ→疲れ：03518_tsukare⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧ (to be hit by exhaustion)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{一気|いっき}に→一気に：16557_ikkini⟧: all at once, in one go. Controlled and often deliberate — you drink or finish something 一気⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧; どっと is what happens to you.
- ⟦{急|きゅう}に→急に：00263_kyuuni⟧: suddenly. About timing only, with no sense of volume.
- ⟦ばっと→ばっと：11590_batto⟧: in a flash. Quick and sharp, typically one action or one person, where どっと implies mass.
